title: Asymmetric algorithmic organization of relational memory
scientific_question: What computational theory is jointly supported when the confirmed global/local causal decomposition, exact local compression, and failed global closure tests are considered together?
scope: This synthesis reorganizes immutable existing evidence. It introduces no new model fit, seed, checkpoint replay, human analysis, statistical test, threshold, or scientific result.

three_level_theory.phenomenology: The frozen v2.4 map reproduces six of nine registered phenomena and qualitatively reproduces but quantitatively mismatches three; none is absent.
three_level_theory.functional_decomposition: Selective effective evidence enters P_T for global abstraction and remote reassembly, while broader weak observed evidence enters the query-addressed local state for direct relational fidelity. P-off and local-off interventions establish a replicated functional double dissociation.
three_level_theory.algorithmic_asymmetry: The local tensor implementation is exactly equivalent to an additive edge state plus fixed Gram read, whereas the global near-additive potential is an output observable whose learning dynamics are not closed by the registered potential, bilinear, task-ledger, or fixed linear functional-P states.

frozen_equations.global_implementation: P_(t+1)=the unchanged meta-learned recurrent plastic update acting on the interacting fast-weight state
frozen_equations.global_output: m^G_ij(P_T) is approximately s_i-s_j at terminal readout

supported_claims: Within the frozen model family, P_T is necessary for remote/global relational assembly and the addressed local state selectively supports direct fidelity.
The local branch has an exact edge-addressed algorithmic representation under its frozen address kernel.
The global terminal field is nearly additive even though the tested reduced states do not close its learning dynamics.
History-dependent update amount and relational allocation are both computational requirements; scalar and item ledgers expose complementary parts but neither is sufficient.
A simple low-dimensional output geometry does not imply a stable low-dimensional coordinate system for the learning computation.
rejected_or_closed_routes: potential-only rank-2 and unconstrained bilinear closure
scalar count, energy, time, block, or other hand-designed global history ledgers
item-wise or pair-wise task-derived history ledgers and post-hoc scalar-plus-item mixtures
fixed cross-episode supervised linear projections of residual alpha elementwise-multiplied by P_t
continuing reduced-algorithm search by changing rank, ridge, P normalization, PCA, or nonlinear kernels after the registered failures
claim_boundaries: Do not say the global algorithm is intrinsically high-dimensional or that no compact sufficient state can exist.
Nonlinear, trajectory-dependent, or episode-coordinate-dependent compact variables remain logically possible but are not currently licensed as a search program.
Do not call P_T and a_T biologically separate stores or identify them with unique neural substrates.
Do not claim the tensor-product address, Gram kernel, admission probability, or recurrent implementation is unique.
Do not infer the human mechanism from model phenomenology or model-internal causal interventions.
Retain the three quantitative behavioral mismatches and the formal DA-direction heterogeneity.

roadmap.current: Freeze and communicate the asymmetric computational theory; do not produce new scientific data in this stage.
roadmap.next_model_question: Does the functional asymmetry, rather than a particular reduced coordinate, generalize across relational-learning regimes?
roadmap.first_generalization_priority: Prospectively register a one-to-three-seed list-linking pilot in which two learned sequences are connected by one bridge relation. Test P-dependent remote restructuring against a-dependent bridge/direct fidelity with the same selective ablations.
roadmap.ancestry_question: Only after the asymmetric theory is frozen, compare the global branch with the Miconi active/reinstatement computational motif at the operator and causal-function level, not by latent-coordinate alignment.
roadmap.human_experiments: Deferred. No current model claim requires new human data.
